node_contract.what: Run pass 23 critic review and harden quality-certificate validation.
node_contract.why: The transcript requires certificates at every stage; a certificate without executable validation is only ceremony.
node_contract.how: Add a certificate validator, positive fixture, negative fixtures, runner checks, skill guidance, and pass records.

expert_debate.system_theorist: Certificates are closure objects; if weak, they falsely collapse unresolved work into done.
expert_debate.requirements_governance_architect: Certificate threshold lowering and reviewer identity must follow the same waiver and trace discipline as other gates.
expert_debate.verification_safety_critic: A pass certificate must mechanically prove panel evidence, cross-critique evidence, failed-point handling, refinery linkage, and score sufficiency.
expert_debate.synthesis: Add executable certificate validation and preserve semantic truth as a residual risk for real project simulations.

human_decisions: Human owner requested pass 23 and asked to fix new findings.
assumptions: Pass 23 is a patch-level certificate hardening pass, not a full greenfield or brownfield simulation.
risks: Certificate validator proves evidence structure and linkage, not real-world correctness of the certified artifact.
